title: Create a Bell State
subtitle: Build the maximally entangled state |Φ+⟩
description: Construct a quantum circuit that produces the Bell state |Φ+⟩ = (|00⟩ + |11⟩)/√2. This is the most fundamental entangled state in quantum computing — two qubits perfectly correlated so that measuring one instantly determines the other.
hint: You need exactly two gates: one to create superposition, and one to entangle.
objectives: Learn the H + CNOT pattern for Bell state preparation
